About — see creatures About Patterns Murals The Pattern Cloud Poster Shop Menu see creatures About Patterns Murals The Pattern Cloud Poster Shop mailing address Workflow Studio, 11 Freehold Terrace, Brighton. also check out … a library of creatures - our archive of vintage books on instagram the know ideas podcast - dan is co-host of this creative pod See Creatures Studio See Creatures is a creative design studio based in Brighton, UK. Creating thoughtful and beautiful designs for clients is the core of all our work. We love what we do and specialise in prints for fashion, homeware and products, working to the fast pace of emerging trends to create fresh designs for aspirational brands. Founded in 2014, by Artist and Print Designer, Dan Walters. His 20+ years experience in the surface pattern design industry has enabled the studio to grow worldwide. Joined in 2016 by Sarah Kelly as Studio Manager, and a small team of talented and experienced in-house designers a year later, the studio has grown and continues to produce high quality, unique, curated and inspiring collections for kidswear, menswear, womenswear, active, products and swim. The studio is amongst other awesome creatives at Workflow Studio at Rodhus in Brighton. Alongside surface pattern design, we also create large murals, design interiors, art direct projects and design brand identities for a range of clients. We enjoy being part of both the global and local design community and are open to collaborations and projects of any size. selected clients The North Face, Columbia Sportswear, Babble Hove, Boden, Amazon, Gap Inc, RVCA, Speck, Chubbies Shorts, Tattly, Target, MEC, John Lewis, Paperchase, M&S, Oliver Jane, Mothercare, Little Bird, Frugi, Built NY, Bonobos, Tommy Hilfiger, InMocean, Gymboree, The Children’s Place, Carter’s, Bluemint, Monoprix, Kipling, Pottery Barn, Hanna Andersson, J.Crew, REI, Bison Beer, Sunuva, Guess? Jeans, Finger in the Nose, White Cloud Coffee, Sea Lanes Brighton, Osh Kosh, Like the Wind Magazine. Back to Top email: [email protected]
